releases.title: Statewide Intelligence Compiler
releases.summary: Replaced the planned requirement to warehouse every statewide MOD-IV parcel with a lean intelligence compiler. The validated 3,208,097-row 2026 source now produces compact municipality, county and statewide benchmarks across all 564 New Jersey municipalities and 21 counties. Added 24 transparent Watchdog-derived professional signals, including assessment dispersion, assessment-jump prevalence, property-class mix, turnover, building-age exposure, sale-assessment dispersion and parcel-value context. The aggregate production artifact is under 2 MB; raw and person-level source data remain outside the browser and Git. The optional private warehouse remains available for future selected historical workloads without forcing a database-plan upgrade today.

releases.title: Private historical property warehouse foundation
releases.status: Schema deployed; 2026 bulk load awaiting trusted DB connection
releases.summary: Deployed Watchdog's first private historical warehouse to Supabase. Five RLS-enabled tables now version source releases, load runs, privacy-limited MOD-IV observations, data-quality results and the explicitly published release pointer; anon and authenticated roles have no warehouse table privileges. Added a streaming PostgreSQL COPY loader for the validated 3,208,097-row 2026 MOD-IV baseline plus a separate review/approve/publish command. Dataset publication cannot happen during ingestion, and publishing requires the exact reviewed release UUID to be confirmed. The local preflight passes 21/21 normalized county partitions; the actual 3.2M-row warehouse COPY remains intentionally pending until a trusted database connection is configured locally.

releases.title: Watchdog Data Factory v1 and 2026 statewide baseline
releases.summary: Built the first governed statewide ingestion layer for Watchdog. The 2026 Treasury MOD-IV archive validates across all 21 county partitions with 3,208,097 source records and zero structural failures, then normalizes only approved property/tax fields into Git-ignored work products. Added a privacy-limited live connector for NJGIN's current statewide parcel service, whose validation run reports 3,478,727 parcel geometries with all 38 approved fields present and zero forbidden owner/mailing fields requested. Registered the July 2026 DCA Data Hub inventory as the acquisition map, added daily live-source contract checks, and surfaced the complete review gate in developer-only Data Operations. No validated source automatically becomes customer-facing data.

releases.title: Payment backend deployment and launch safety gate
releases.status: Backend deployed; Stripe account review pending
releases.summary: Deployed the complete Stripe billing backend to Supabase: authenticated Checkout, authenticated Customer Portal and a signature-verified public Stripe webhook. Verified the existing live $49 Pro and $149 Pro+ recurring prices and registered the production webhook destination, which remains disabled until its signing secret is installed and Stripe clears the account for charges. Added the Stripe-hosted Customer Portal login to Account & Billing for active paid customers. Checkout is deny-by-default behind a server-only BILLING_CHECKOUT_ENABLED switch. Public Pro and Pro+ CTAs remain early-access until sandbox lifecycle validation and Stripe account approval are complete.

releases.title: New Jersey bulk-data intelligence expansion
releases.summary: Added 154 governed Pro+ markers from eleven high-value statewide DCA and NJDEP source families: raw parcel-linked permits, development trends, new-home warranties, municipal housing profiles, affordable-housing monitoring, community assets, zoning-directory links, PILOT forecasts, MOD-IV longitudinal history, neighborhood trends and contaminated-site remediation data. The governed catalog now contains 697 markers, including 262 transparent Watchdog-derived signals. Added an incremental DCA raw-permit importer that joins official Treasury municipality code, block and lot, plus a source activation catalog that makes live-vs-catalog status explicit.

releases.title: Cross-professional marker expansion and mobile navigation foundation
releases.summary: Added 100 transparent Watchdog-derived markers—ten for each of ten professional audiences—with formula, professional reason, access tier and dependency-refresh contract. The governed marker catalog now contains 543 fields, including 218 proprietary Watchdog signals. Added a staging-only, browser-level anonymous access smoke test that refuses the production domain. Mobile navigation now uses a clean More sheet with grouped workspace, research and account destinations, large touch targets, safe-area handling, keyboard dismissal, focus visibility and reduced-motion support.

releases.title: Protected-route and entitlement regression audit
releases.summary: Added a source-level access-boundary contract that runs automatically on GitHub pull requests and main pushes. It checks each known signed-in and developer-only route, verifies the server-evaluated developer check and anonymous RPC revocations, confirms core entitlement/RLS primitives, and fails if a service credential appears in browser-delivered property files. The initial audit passes 38 checks. A staged live-RLS test remains the next operational gate before paid enrollment.

releases.title: Mobile product clarity and production-readiness control
releases.summary: Turned the developer View As control into a compact phone control that opens only when needed, so it no longer blocks report or dashboard content. Pro and Developer views now label the mobile destination as Tools rather than Pro, paid property cards remove the empty upgrade action, and secondary dashboard signals are collapsed on phones until requested. Home prioritizes four primary facts and moves secondary market metrics out of the first mobile scan. Data Operations now displays a developer-only 42% production-readiness baseline and staged path to launch-grade SaaS.

releases.title: NJ source monitoring and commercial-property context
releases.summary: Connected the source-change watcher to a service-role-only Supabase ingestion function and scheduled GitHub workflow. A changed authoritative NJ source now creates a private Property Pulse review event for opted-in saved properties, without claiming a parcel changed before validation. Commercial parcels are visibly distinguished on Dashboard and Watchlist, suppress residential market-value and Chapter 123 presentation, and receive commercial-specific research language. Enlarged key mobile controls and property actions for thumb-friendly use.

releases.title: Property Pulse and installable app foundation
releases.summary: Added Property Pulse: an authenticated change center with per-property preferences for score, tax, assessment and deadline signals, plus a server-only event inbox designed for future source-monitor jobs and native push delivery. Added an installable PWA shell with iPhone Home Screen guidance, an offline-safe reconnect page and a service worker that deliberately never caches private property data.

releases.title: Institutional 100-marker data release
releases.summary: Added exactly 100 governed markers: 50 authoritative NJ public-source observations across geology, hydrography, land/historic resources and municipal finance, plus 50 transparent Watchdog-derived professional signals spanning attorneys/title, lenders, real estate, investors, developers, appraisers and insurance/risk. Expanded the live NJDEP diligence query layer, added professional-purpose metadata, formula lineage, source monitoring and marker refresh contracts, and moved the governed catalog from 343 to 443 markers.

releases.title: Professional workflow suite and longitudinal Watchdog Score
releases.summary: Completed roadmap priorities 2–7 as integrated professional workflows: collateral/escrow stress, expanded permit lifecycle intelligence, NJDEP/NJGS development constraints, private appeal case tracking, a broker listing brief and portfolio carry-cost concentration. Added genuine dated Watchdog Score observations with up/down ticker and trend chart, plus contextual John/Heather buyer and seller strategy CTAs that keep agent branding inside real-estate guidance surfaces.

releases.title: Customer-access lockdown and readability pass
releases.summary: Restricted internal operations, roadmap/history, diagnostics, Data Center, scanner and legacy analysis prototypes to the server-confirmed developer role; removed email and user-metadata authorization shortcuts; kept Standard marker detail available to signed-in Standard accounts while withholding paid marker detail; closed Pro/Pro+ checkout enrollment in favor of early access; removed personal-name footer branding; and increased undersized dashboard/card typography across desktop and mobile.

releases.title: ANCHOR-to-Watchdog conversion bridge
releases.summary: Turned the estimator address into a Google-assisted NJ address field, added persistent first/last-touch campaign attribution and funnel events, introduced a 0-100 Watchdog intent score on verified leads, and added a compact post-result Watchdog transition: homeowners see a personalized parcel/tax snapshot while renters see aggregated nearby ownership context instead of subject-property claims.

releases.title: Appeal Opportunity workflow and unified town-page design
releases.summary: Launched the Watchdog Appeal Opportunity Index for per-property Pro triage, upgraded the municipality-wide Appeal Prospect Scanner into a true Pro+ workspace with entitlement-aware access and opportunity ranking, added the scanner to professional navigation, expanded the marker catalog to 343 fields, and aligned all 564 public town reports with Dashboard/Home typography, navy-teal palette, cards, spacing and mobile behavior.

releases.title: Statewide town-report publishing system
releases.summary: Added a generated public-report system for all 564 New Jersey municipalities, 21 county hubs, a searchable town directory, canonical metadata, answer-ready FAQs, structured data, rate and assessment context, Watchdog conversion paths, and statewide sitemap coverage. The pages regenerate from the local municipal datasets after each state-data refresh.

releases.title: Commercial SaaS and data-governance foundation
releases.summary: Built Stripe Checkout, Customer Portal and signed subscription-webhook code; moved paid-plan reads toward server entitlements; added Pro+ RLS-protected saved Data Center views; launched the developer-only 342-marker refresh-control center and six-hour NJ publisher-change monitoring; added Account & Billing, Terms, Privacy and Data Methodology; and repositioned Watchdog as the product publisher instead of personal developer branding.

releases.title: Next-100 marker program and SaaS production foundation
releases.summary: Defined the next 100 professional markers across ten disciplines, activated five formula-backed cross-professional decision signals, raised the live catalog to 342 markers, and added the first server-owned entitlement and access-audit foundation for production SaaS gating.

releases.title: Professional intelligence scoring layer
releases.summary: Polished Home's compact signal cards by removing the legacy teal pseudo-element rail and duplicate hidden headings; launched Investor Carry-Cost Volatility, Appeal Evidence Strength and Permit Lifecycle Intelligence; promoted ten formula-backed Real Estate Professional markers; and added a documented derived-marker formula registry plus a Git terminal deployment workflow.

releases.title: Developer login workspace repair
releases.summary: Fixed the post-login Dashboard failure for Developer and paid accounts. The standard Dashboard was calling the lazy Pro percentile painter before its module had loaded. The call is now capability-guarded, and Dashboard/Home no longer create a second Supabase auth client through plan simulation.

releases.title: Progressive data disclosure and developer plan simulation
releases.summary: Home now converts full tool reports into compact signal rows: hover or focus explains the reading, clicking opens the sourced marker page, and the original full tool is available only on demand. Removed remaining left-edge rails, repaired Data Center row density, added Pricing to the public header, introduced a server-backed Developer role with Standard/Pro/Pro+ View As simulation, and documented 90 proprietary professional markers plus a 15-part SaaS maturity pipeline.

releases.title: Universal data marker intelligence
releases.summary: Replaced Home's colored report rails with a quieter app-style category system, concise scan-first summaries and neutral open cards. Added desktop hover previews and a universal click-through detail experience for all 324 catalog markers, including value context, methodology, plan/profession metadata, related markers and source provenance. The 13 primary Home signals also receive richer editorial explanations and direct authoritative source links.

releases.title: Mobile app polish for Dashboard and Home
releases.summary: Reworked the phone hierarchy for Dashboard and Home with larger typography and tap targets, floating safe-area navigation, photo-first property presentation, denser but more readable property metrics, compact report chrome and a true full-width Agent Intel bottom sheet on both pages.

releases.title: Professional intelligence foundation and Pro+ Data Center
releases.summary: Fixed the expanding desktop navigation scroll region; added a 323-marker tier/profession registry; launched the Pro+ Data Center field builder; expanded Closing Evidence with flood/wetlands constraints; and added Post-Closing Escrow Shock plus a municipal lien/tax-sale research workspace.

releases.title: Professional Due Diligence and navigation polish
releases.summary: Added a lazy-loaded closing and collateral preflight backed by live NJ DCA permit/certificate records and NJDEP contaminated-site, deed-notice, groundwater CEA, underground-storage-tank, Tidelands, Highlands and Pinelands layers. Redesigned the shared desktop sidebar into animated drill-down groups with a separate five-item mobile navigation, removed Dashboard metric dividers, rounded and polished Home Agent Intel, and made Historical Property Time Machine collapsed by default.

releases.title: Exempt/PILOT, Added/Omitted and Farmland tools
releases.summary: Completed roadmap items 3, 4 and 5 as separate lazy-loaded tools. Added statewide exempt-property/PILOT exposure from the 2025 Abstract and DCA's 2026 PILOT database, a saved-property added/omitted assessment monitor with current AA-1 deadline guidance, and a 2026 Farmland Assessment qualification/rollback screener. Also repaired Dashboard property cards so Assessed, Tax, Market Value and both intelligence strips remain visible on desktop and mobile.

releases.title: Municipal Budget Pressure
releases.summary: Built a statewide municipal fiscal-pressure model from five years of NJ DCA tax tables plus the User-Friendly Budget Database. Added explainable pressure bands, levy and organic-ratable trends, municipal/school/county components, budget growth, debt, collections and structural-imbalance context across Dashboard, Home, Agent Intel, town reports, town comparison and exports.

releases.title: Shared home-ownership verification flow
releases.summary: Changed Claim as my home so it immediately offers postcard verification after saving, added an explicit Not now path that leaves the home unverified, repaired Verify ownership on Home, and moved Lookup, Dashboard and Home onto one shared verification module.

releases.title: EmailJS administrator delivery for manual postcards
releases.summary: Connected the secure verification worker to the existing EmailJS account and template. Codes and mailing instructions go only to the administrator, while the EmailJS private key remains protected in Supabase secrets.

releases.title: Mobile property-card repair and manual postcard fulfillment
releases.summary: Corrected Town Intelligence so property cards no longer receive an undefined status class, allowed mobile cards to grow with their data, and replaced PostGrid with a secure administrator-email workflow for manually mailed verification postcards.

releases.title: Verification delivery, Property Time Machine and state-data automation
releases.summary: Added secure postal ownership-code delivery infrastructure and diagnostics, upgraded assessment drift into a detailed Historical Property Time Machine, added a review-first automated state-data refresh pipeline, and repaired expansion of the shared sidebar on every page.

roadmap.title: Lead conversion intelligence and CRM handoff
roadmap.readiness: Estimator attribution, milestone events and intent scoring shipped in v0.22.0; durable server-side event collection and CRM routing next
roadmap.why: The consumer funnel can now identify campaign source and intent in the browser and verified lead notification. The production step is a server-owned event history so conversion quality, source ROI, follow-up speed and closed-business attribution can be measured without depending on email or a single browser.
